name: stolen-token-lab
description: Stolen-token lab (C22): replay a captured access token through a mock gateway and see what stops it: nothing (bearer), audience binding, DPoP (RFC 9449), or mTLS certificate binding (RFC 8705, simulated). Mock only: in-process, no tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
